citation: Saudi Arabia: the Implementing Regulations of the Anti-Money Laundering Law (Royal Decree M/20, 1439H) and SAMA's Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Rules for financial institutions, read with the Ministry of Commerce's beneficial-owner requirements under the Companies Law (Royal Decree M/132, 1443H): a beneficial owner is a natural person who ultimately owns or controls, directly or indirectly, 25% or more of the legal person, or otherwise exercises control. Confirm the articles and the revision in force with the institution's compliance officer before go-live.
